description: This is a C# source file defining the ClusterHealthMonitor class, which manages monitoring the health and membership status of silos within an Orleans cluster. It includes logic for updating monitored silos, processing membership updates, handling lifecycle events, and performing health checks.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitor
classes.description: Manages the health monitoring of silos within an Orleans cluster, including updating monitored silos, processing membership updates, reacting to lifecycle events, and health checking silos.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitor.ITestAccessor
classes.description: Provides internal accessors for testing purposes, exposing monitored silos, monitor creation, observed membership version, and probe result handler.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronously processes membership table updates to manage monitored silos, eviction of stale silos, and membership version updates.

methods.name: EvictStaleStateSilos
methods.description: Evicts silos that have exceeded maximum allowed join time or are in creating/joining state.

methods.name: UpdateMonitoredSilos
methods.description: Determines which silos to monitor based on membership data, number of silos, suspected statuses, and performs probabilistic selection using hash rings.

methods.name: OnProbeResultInternal
methods.description: Default handler for probe results; suspects or kills silos if probe failures exceed configured limits.
